description.narrative:
This 12-month Young Women Climate Leadership Programme strengthens young women’s influence on Sierra Leone’s NDC 3.0. Twenty young women aged 18–25, drawn from all 16 districts, including 50 percent from rural areas and at least 30 percent young women with disabilities, will complete six months of advocacy-focused training and mentorship, followed by six months of coordinated policy engagement. The cohort will lead consultations with young women nationwide and draft a Youth and Gender Climate Position Paper aligned to NDC3.0 priorities. In month eight, the cohort will present the paper at a national stakeholder roundtable with the EPA, Ministry of Environment and Climate Change, and Ministry of Gender and Children’s Affairs. Follow-up meetings, institutional visits, and public communications will secure written commitments, focal persons, and responses. Graduates will join an alumni network to sustain advocacy beyond the project.
Goal: Increase young women’s influence on the implementation of Sierra Leone’s NDC 3.0.
Objectives: (1) Build policy advocacy, analysis, and negotiation skills among 20 young women through training and mentorship. (2) Support the cohort to consult young women nationwide and draft a Youth and Gender Climate Position Paper linked to NDC 3.0. (3) Secure institutional commitments through structured engagement with key ministries.
Activities: open selection, six months of training and mentorship, national consultations, position paper drafting, stakeholder roundtable, follow-up meetings, institutional visits, and public advocacy actions.

participating-org.narrative:
Youth Initiative for Climate Action–Sierra Leone (YICA-SL) is a youth-led non-profit organisation that advances climate action and environmental justice in Sierra Leone. The organisation works through policy advocacy, youth capacity building, community organising, and youth-led climate adaptation and resilience initiatives. YICA-SL focuses on ensuring that young people move from awareness to action and from consultation to influence in climate decision-making.
Vision
YICA-SL envisions a sustainable and climate-resilientSierra Leone where young people actively shape climate solutions, protect the environment, and support community development.
Mission
The mission of YICA-SL is to empower and mobilise young people to act as effective advocates, leaders, and changemakers in addressing climate change and its impacts.
Objectives
YICA-SL aims to raise awareness of climate change and its local impacts on communities. The organisation builds the skills and leadership capacity of young people to engage in climate action and sustainable development. It promotes community engagement and partnerships to strengthen environmental conservation and climate resilience. YICA-SL advocates for policies and governance systems that prioritise climate resilience, inclusion, and sustainability. It also supports andshowcases youth-led initiatives that deliver practical solutions for climate adaptation and mitigation.
Values
YICA-SL operates on the values of youth leadership, inclusion, accountability, collaboration, and evidence-based action. The organisation centres marginalised youth, including young women and persons with disabilities, and promotes integrity, transparency, and community service in all its work.
